brand.subtitle: A tool based on the IV Calculator for comparing training candidates with your Pokémon
brand.browser title: Pokémon Performance Ranking | IV Calculator for Pokémon Sleep

ingredientRanking.toxtricity nature note: Toxtricity forms incompatible with the selected nature are excluded.
ingredientRanking.cross ranking pattern note: Every ingredient configuration for each Pokémon is ranked as a separate candidate.
ingredientRanking.ranking uses selected levels: Uses the ranking level above and each comparison Pokémon's actual level.

about.about1: This application is a fork based on <upstream>nitoyon/pokesleep-tool</upstream>, originally developed by nitoyon.
about.about2: This fork contains independent modifications and is maintained by <maintainer>takus69</maintainer>. Its source code is available at <source>takus69/pokesleep-tool</source>.
about.about3: I am referring to the data from '<wiki>ポケモンスリープ攻略・検証Wiki</wiki>', '<rp>RP collection project</rp>' and '<raenonx>RaenonX</raenonx>'. The ingredient icon was created by ちゃんりわ.
about.about4: Feel free to use this tool's data, simulation results, screenshots and so on. If you do, a credit mentioning this tool would be appreciated.
about.about5: This is an unofficial fan-made application. It is not affiliated with, endorsed, sponsored, or approved by Nintendo, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc., The Pokémon Company, or their affiliates.

scenario.energy unavailable: Energy settings could not be calculated. Check the individual conditions.
scenario.skill level note: The skill level includes Skill Level Up. Event and field bonuses apply afterwards, capped at the skill maximum.
scenario.metric note specific ingredient count: Counts only the selected ingredient from regular helping; ingredients gained from skills are excluded.
scenario.metric note ingredient strength: Ranks the total energy of all ingredients gained from regular helping, including ingredients other than the selected filter.
scenario.metric note skill count: Ranks expected skill trigger count, not effect strength or team contribution.
scenario.mythical same: Same ingredient in all three slots
scenario.mythical note: Same ingredient in all three slots includes every valid configuration such as three Herb slots.
scenario.partial result: These are partial results. Rankings update as calculation continues.
scenario.cancelled: Calculation cancelled. Use Calculate to run again.
scenario.stale: Conditions changed. These are previous results; recalculate to update.
scenario.stale comparison: Recalculate the ranking before evaluating this comparison.
scenario.neutral slots: {{count}} equivalent sub-skill slots without performance effects are grouped.
scenario.reason invalidMetric: This metric is unavailable for this purpose.
scenario.reason incompatibleNature: Nature is incompatible with this form.
scenario.reason unknownRate: The ingredient or skill rate is not set.
scenario.reason calculationFailed: The individual could not be calculated.
scenario.reason invalidValue: The calculation returned an invalid value.
